responsibility: Defines the Epiphany backend’s machine constraints used by RTL recognition, reload, and instruction selection. It classifies immediates such as 5-bit, 11-bit, small 16-bit, arithmetic, symbolic, return-address, and FP-mode constants, and names target register classes such as short-instruction, sibcall, and control-register classes, so patterns in epiphany.md can precisely accept operands that fit the ISA’s short encodings, call/jump forms, special return-address handling, and mode-switch support.
